correctness.rationale: Source RESULT.md computes all four symmetry types Juv,Juz,Jvz,Jzz by block Schur complements. Jzz−Juv=[2(a²+b²)+(m−4)(mab+c(a+b))]/[2(a+b)(mab+c(a+b))]>0; Juz−Juv=(c*−c)/(mab+b²+c(a+b)). Juz≤Jvz for c>=c* via decreasing affine P(c) with P(c*)<0. Quadratic discriminant m²−8m+8 gives the m>=7 wedge. Independently tested 112 grounded inverses using exact rational matrices at m=4..9 and multiple weights. Continuous all-c conclusions rest on algebra, not samples.
